character.name: Monkey D. Luffy
character.scope: Supplied brief only. No external canon beyond the quoted passages.

documents.text: Monkey D. Luffy fights with elastic stretching strikes at close range; this rubbery brawling identity persists across his specializations. He trains three distinct Haki disciplines that can coexist: Armament hardening for harder hits, Observation for sensing enemies, and Conqueror's presence for overwhelming groups. He also develops successive Gear transformations that grow stronger in sequence but drain stamina, forcing recovery in his base form. Gears build on one another rather than competing as alternative identities.

A Tower Defense Unit has three upgrade paths, each with five sequential tiers. A placed Unit may purchase at most two paths; at most one path may exceed tier 2. Attacks require a detected target within attack range and a clear delivery path. Numerical ranges, damage, cooldowns and costs are intentionally unspecified. Shared stamina-limited form progression is not part of this public ruleset; record it as reserved or omitted rather than granting it silently.
